business.name: Mr Handyworks LLC
business.introduction:
Hi, I’m Mr Handyworks LLC, owner of Mr. Handyworks LLC. I provide professional home repairs, installations, and remodeling services; done right the first time.
From TV mounting and fixture installations to carpentry, painting, and general repairs, I take pride in delivering clean, precise work with strong attention to detail. No shortcuts, no guesswork, just solid, dependable results.
Most of my work comes from repeat clients and referrals, which reflects the quality and consistency I bring to every job.
Mr. Handyworks LLC is fully insured and bonded, so you can have peace of mind knowing your home is in safe, professional hands. I believe in clear communication, fair pricing, and showing up when I say I will.
If you’re looking for someone reliable who treats your home with respect and takes pride in the work, I’m ready to help.

reviews.author: Jyoti B.
reviews.text:
Mr Handyworks LLC replaced a shower head, inspected the dryer, and cleaned the dryer vent.

Pros: 1. He was good at communication in general (+1 star)

Cons: 1. Very, very expensive service (-1 star)
2. Wasn't truthful about the material cost. We found that out when I asked for the receipt. That raises questions about whether he is being honest about the rest of the work. (-1 star)
3. We had agreed that he would let me know the cost of all the work after the initial inspection. But he didn't. Had I known what he was going to charge for the shower head alone, I would not have proceeded with the job. (-1 star)

Safe to say, I will not be asking for his services again.
reviews.response:
Hi Jyoti, I’m sorry you feel this way, but I would like to clarify what happened. The original request was to inspect the dryer. You later requested additional work, including cleaning the dryer vent and checking and replacing the shower head. I explained in our messages that these additional services would be priced separately, and you agreed.

The shower head price difference was due to a different color being purchased at a lower price. Once I reviewed the receipt, I sent it to you and corrected the invoice accordingly. This was an honest adjustment, not an attempt to misrepresent the cost.

All work was completed around 6:00 p.m., including the additional services, and payment was not completed until close to midnight after several follow-ups. I respect your decision not to use my services again, but I strongly disagree with the suggestion that I was dishonest.
